references.text: Tola and Jair judged Israel before Jephthah, and the text also describes their period of service and death in a similar manner.
Here Jephthah is introduced as a Gileadite, the same designation used when his death and burial are mentioned.
The judges Ibzan, Elon, and Abdon follow Jephthah with similar phrasing regarding their period of service and death.
Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life, a parallel to Jephthah's role as judge over Israel.
Jephthah is mentioned among the heroes of faith in Hebrews as one of the judges who by faith won victories.
Othniel judged Israel and died, a pattern that is repeated for several judges including Jephthah.
Gideon's period of service, death, and burial are described in a similar manner to Jephthah's.
